title: When does a shuffled deck forget its order?
question: Does the Thorp shuffle on N = 2^d cards have total-variation cutoff at 2 log₂ N physical shuffles?
summary: Every card is uniform after d Thorp shuffles, while counting outcomes forces the whole deck to need about 2d. Recent OpenAI preprints claim mixing in a constant multiple of d but leave the sharp transition unresolved. Compute exact small-deck laws, identify surviving correlations, and sharpen full-deck upper bounds to test cutoff at 2d.
